description: Get current gas on Arbitrum One: gas price, base fee and suggested priority fee in gwei, plus what a plain ETH transfer (21,000 gas) costs right now. Takes no input. Use before sending a transaction or to decide whether to wait; for the fee a past transaction actually paid use arb_receipt. Example: only=. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=fastestFee,halfHourFee); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result

name: arb_gas
title: Arbitrum One gas price
